strategies.name: Avellaneda–Stoikov Inventory-Aware Market Making
strategies.alpha: Spread capture subject to inventory-risk aversion; reservation price r=S-q*gamma*sigma^2*T; optimal spread gamma*sigma^2*T+2/gamma*ln(1+gamma/k).
strategies.signal: Continuously update mid, inventory, volatility and order-arrival intensity; post bid/ask around reservation price; cancel/exit at inventory or drawdown limits.
strategies.parameters: gamma, sigma, k, horizon, tick size, inventory cap; maker/taker fee and latency budget
strategies.data: L2/L3 order-book and trades, queue position, fees
strategies.risk: Adverse selection, queue priority, stale quotes, adverse fills, latency, inventory blow-up
strategies.empirical: Theoretical control model; no independently verified net Sharpe or max DD.
strategies.stack: Python NumPy; LOB replay simulator, Z-QCC risk; sandbox only
strategies.steps: Replay L2 events -> calibrate arrival rates -> simulate queue/fills -> stress inventory and latency -> no live execution

strategies.name: Pástor–Stambaugh Liquidity Risk Premium
strategies.alpha: Price covariance with unexpected aggregate market liquidity; beta_L=cov(stock excess returns, liquidity innovation)/var(liquidity innovation).
strategies.signal: Monthly estimate liquidity innovations from signed-volume-related return reversal; regress each stock on liquidity innovations with market controls; buy high beta_L, short low beta_L in research.
strategies.market_frequency: US equities; daily signals aggregated to monthly
strategies.parameters: 36-60 month estimation, industry/size neutralization, liquidity floors
strategies.data: CRSP-like PIT returns, volume, market factors, delisting data
strategies.risk: Nontraded factor construction, noisy beta, microcaps, crisis drawdowns, market-beta confounding
strategies.empirical: Original 1966-1999 sample: high minus low liquidity-beta stocks 7.5% per year risk-adjusted to market, size, value, momentum; not net implementable return.
strategies.institution: No exact live strategy adopter verified
strategies.stack: Pandas/NumPy, PIT market data, Z-QCC covariance engine
strategies.steps: Construct market liquidity factor -> lag release -> rolling beta -> neutralize -> costed walk-forward

strategies.name: Nonlinear ML Cross-Sectional Return Forecasting
strategies.alpha: Gradient-boosted trees/random forests/neural nets learn nonlinear interactions among lagged stock characteristics; distinct from IPCA latent factor estimation.
strategies.signal: Monthly point-in-time features -> expanding walk-forward model -> rank predicted next-month excess returns -> top quintile long, optional bottom quintile short.
strategies.market_frequency: US stocks; daily OHLCV + quarterly PIT fundamentals, monthly trading
strategies.parameters: Min 10y train, 1y validation, embargo and nested tuning, turnover cap, model drift
strategies.data: Survivorship-free stock universe, OHLCV, accounting, macro and delisting returns
strategies.risk: Look-ahead, survivorship, data snooping, cross-sectional dependence, turnover and licensing
strategies.empirical: Gu/Kelly/Xiu (2020) report ML gains and in some cases roughly double regression-strategy performance, not a transferable exact Sharpe. Independent GitHub replication self-reports gross Sharpe 0.916/net 0.493 for OLS, NOT this model and not independently audited.
strategies.institution: AQR-affiliated coauthor is not proof of live implementation
strategies.stack: scikit-learn, pandas, feature store, model registry, Z-QCC backtest
strategies.steps: PIT features -> train/validation split -> fit nonlinear model -> freeze model -> costed OOS portfolio test

strategies.name: Same-Calendar-Month Cross-Sectional Seasonality
strategies.alpha: Stock-specific returns repeat in the same calendar month across years; signal is average same-month excess return over prior 5-10 years.
strategies.signal: Before each month use only prior same-month observations; rank seasonal alpha; buy high scores, short low scores or long-only screened top; exit at month end.
strategies.parameters: 5/10-year lookback, >=5 observations, price/ADV floors, sector neutrality
strategies.data: PIT total returns, delisting and exchange calendar
strategies.risk: Small samples, January effect, delisted names, multiple testing, high turnover
strategies.empirical: Original Heston/Sadka (2008) document same-month predictability over long lags; international follow-up reports global seasonal strategies outperform nonseasonal by >1%/month in studied samples, not net for this rule.
strategies.stack: Pandas, PIT price database, Z-QCC ranking/cost engine
strategies.steps: Build lagged monthly returns -> exclude current month -> seasonal rank -> control calendar/industry -> OOS backtest

strategies.name: Embedded Leverage Relative-Value Premium
strategies.alpha: Leverage-constrained investors pay for leverage embedded in options and leveraged ETFs, lowering risk-adjusted returns; distinguish from BAB asset-beta spread and index variance risk premium.
strategies.signal: Measure effective leverage and total fees; rank comparable exposure instruments; prefer low embedded leverage after delta/beta/risk matching; avoid naive naked shorts.
strategies.parameters: Delta, gamma, leverage factor, financing, borrow, volatility decay, fee drag
strategies.data: PIT option chains, ETF NAV/holdings, borrow and financing rates
strategies.risk: Nonlinear payoff mismatch, path dependence, volatility decay, hard-to-borrow, tail losses
strategies.empirical: Frazzini/Pedersen working paper reports abnormal-return t-statistics 8.6 equity options, 6.3 index options, 2.5 ETFs; these are NOT Sharpe or net performance.
strategies.institution: Authors affiliated with AQR; live exact-strategy AUM not verified
strategies.stack: QuantLib/vectorbt reference, Z-QCC option Greeks and risk
strategies.steps: Construct comparable delta/beta matched legs -> estimate all-in costs -> scenario stress -> costed paper backtest
